$description: Semantic spacing of the default theme: the roles (`role`: an inset with an `x` and a `y`, or a gap), the component sizes (`size`: a height, an `x` and `y` padding, a gap) and the exceptions (`exception.<role>--<pattern>`: a place that keeps its own value; the pattern spells it, phone then desktop, or `fixed-<n>`). Each value has a `base` and an `md` (from the md breakpoint).

inset-tight.$description: Padding of a small inline box: a chip that is not a Tag, code, a tooltip, a compact popover menu, an icon wrapper.

inset-item.$description: Padding of one item among peers that steps up on desktop: data list rows, accordion headers and bodies, selectable cards, definition list rows.

inset-item-flat.$description: Padding of one item among peers that keeps one size at every width: menu items, list rows inside menus and pickers, compact rows.

inset-surface.$description: Padding of a standalone surface that steps up on desktop: card, panel, dialog header, body and footer, alert, empty state.

inset-surface-flat.$description: Padding of a small standalone surface that keeps one size: popovers, menus, compact cards and boxes.

inset-surface-wide.$description: Padding of a large panel, 24 px at every width: aside cards, settings panels.

inset-flush.$description: Padding that only spaces siblings: a text line or wrapper with no background, border or click target.

gap-tight.$description: Between the parts of one element: icon and label, title and subtitle lines, value and unit, items of one inline cluster.

gap-phrase.$description: Between the inline text fragments of one phrase laid out as flex children: a value and its unit, a count and its noun, a label and its status. Word spacing, not layout.

gap-related.$description: Between the parts of one item or field: label and field, avatar and its text block, item header and its lines, a field and its action.

gap-group.$description: Between peers that keep one gap at every width: items of a list, fields of a form, buttons of a group, a card title row and its content.

gap-group-stepped.$description: Between peers that space out on desktop: card grids, page-level lists, form sections inside a page.

gap-section.$description: Between the sections of a dialog, an aside or a wizard step (24 px at every width).

gap-section-wide.$description: Between the main sections of a page and its large blocks (40 px at every width).

inset-nav-item.$description: Navigation chrome: padding of a navigation link, a nav group label, the account and workspace pickers of the sidebar.

inset-nav-bar.$description: Navigation chrome: padding of the top and mobile header bars and the mobile nav menu.

gap-nav-tight.$description: Navigation chrome: between the parts of one nav element (icon and label, the links of one group).

gap-nav-related.$description: Navigation chrome: between the parts of one nav block (header bar items, footer lines, sidebar header rows).

gap-nav-group.$description: Navigation chrome: between nav groups and blocks of the sidebar.

gap-nav-section.$description: Navigation chrome: between the top-level parts of the sidebar (header, links, footer).

control-sm.$description: Small control: Button sm, icon buttons, toggle-group buttons on phone.

control-md.$description: Default control: Button md, toggle-group buttons from md, icon-only Button.

control-lg.$description: Large control and every text field: Button lg, InputContainer, select, tab trigger block padding.

tag.$description: Tag and badge pill (not a target).

control-label.$description: Inline padding of the label inside a Button.

control-item.$description: Block padding of a target laid out as an item that steps up on desktop: accordion headers, data list action rows, choice cards.

control-item-flat.$description: Block padding of a target laid out as an item that keeps one size: menu items and options.
